title: Front-End Developer (Angular)
description:
**Innspark is a deep\-tech, product\-based OEM specializing in cybersecurity products, AI, cloud solutions, and select hardware offerings such as drones, VTS, and telemedicine systems, with a diverse and evolving portfolio. To learn more, please visit our website: https://innspark.in.** 




  





**﻿Front\-End Developer (Angular) — Innspark** 




**📍 Kollam · 🏢 On\-site · 🕒 Full\-time · 👤 2–3 years experience** 




  





**Are you an Angular developer with a sharp eye for detail and a passion for building polished, well\-tested user interfaces? At InnSpark, we'd love to talk to you.** 




  





**What you'll do** 




**\- Build responsive, accessible UI components with Angular (v15\+) and TypeScript** 




**\- Write and maintain UI automation tests with Playwright (our preferred tool)** 




**\- Write unit tests for components and services (Jasmine/Karma or Jest)** 




**\- Turn Figma/Sketch designs into pixel\-precise, faithful UI** 




**\- Consume REST/GraphQL APIs and manage state cleanly (RxJS, signals, NgRx)** 




**\- Collaborate within Agile/SCRUM ceremonies and contribute to code reviews** 




  





**What you bring** 




**\- 2–3 years hands\-on Angular (TypeScript, components, services, RxJS)** 




**\- Strong HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+)** 




**\- UI automation testing — Playwright preferred (Cypress a plus)** 




**\- Proficiency with Git and conventional commits** 




**\- Experience in Agile/SCRUM teams and CI/CD pipelines** 




**\- Solid grasp of responsive design, cross\-browser behavior, and accessibility (WCAG)** 




**\- Exceptional attention to detail — visual precision and consistency** 




  





**Nice to have** 




**\- State management (NgRx, NGXS, Angular signals)** 




**\- Component libraries (Angular Material, PrimeNG) \& design systems** 




**\- Performance profiling, lazy loading, bundle optimization** 




**\- Code\-coverage gates and automated test reporting in CI** 




  





**What we value** 




**A craftsperson's eye, a quality\-first mindset, and pride in shipping interfaces that are correct, accessible, and maintainable.** 




  





**💡 Don't have every skill on this list? We'd still love to hear from you. If you're passionate about front\-end craft and eager to learn, please apply — the right attitude and willingness to grow matter just as much to us as ticking every box.**

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. * Build admin UI configuration surfaces across platform hardening deliverables
* Build the agent card configuration UI frontend
* Deliver KPI dashboard enhancements


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 5\+ years React (or similar framework) frontend engineering experience
* Experience building chat interfaces and agent card configuration UIs
* Experience building admin or configuration\-heavy UIs
* Dashboard / data\-visualization experience
* Comfortable integrating with Python/FastAPI backends


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building JSON/YAML\-schema\-driven configuration UIs
* Familiarity with KPI/observability dashboard design patterns


 Education
   

  

 B.Tech/BCA/MCA in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; AWS/Azure/GCP certification preferred.

Software Test Engineer
description:
About the Role
 



 We are seeking a detail\-oriented Test Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality of our products by meeting specific testing metrics and quality objectives. Success in this position will be measured by reduction in production defects, testing efficiency, and ability to maintain high\-quality standards throughout the development lifecycle.
 



 Key Performance Indicators
 


* Achieve 95%\+ test coverage for all new features and major updates
* Reduce escaped defects (bugs found in production) by at least 20% within 6 months
* Maintain a defect closure rate of at least 90% for each sprint
* Complete 100% of assigned test cases within sprint timeframes
* Contribute to reducing overall QA cycle time by 15% through process improvements



 Responsibilities
 


* Design, develop, and execute 20\+ comprehensive test plans per quarter, ensuring 90%\+ test coverage
* Create and maintain at least 50 automated test scripts each quarter, with 98% reliability rate
* Identify and log 90% of critical defects before code reaches staging environments
* Reduce average defect resolution time from 72 hours to 48 hours through clear documentation
* Conduct 10\+ cross\-browser/device compatibility tests per release
* Complete performance testing for all new features, ensuring they meet defined performance benchmarks
* Decrease regression testing time by 20% through optimized test suites and automation
* Participate in 100% of sprint planning and review meetings, providing QA perspective
* Submit weekly metrics reports covering test execution status, defect trends, and quality risks
* Mentor 1\-2 junior QA team members per year



 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent work experience)
* 3\+ years of experience in software testing with demonstrable metrics of success
* Proven track record of reducing production defects by at least 15% year over year
* Experience managing 500\+ test cases within test management systems
* Demonstrated ability to automate at least 60% of regression test suites
* Proficiency in at least one testing framework with ability to create 30\+ reliable test scripts per month
* Experience with performance testing, consistently identifying 85% of performance bottlenecks before production
* History of maintaining 95%\+ accuracy in defect reporting and documentation



 Technical Skills
 


* Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript) with ability to write 200\+ lines of clean test code daily
* Experience with test management tools, managing 300\+ test cases simultaneously
* Demonstrated ability to create automated test frameworks that reduce manual testing by 40%
* Knowledge of SQL with ability to validate data integrity across 10\+ database tables
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, reducing build verification time by 25%

title: Associate Architect
description:
**Lead Engineer/Associate Architect – .NET Full Stack** 




  





**Experience:** 
 8–10 yrs
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Office, Hybrid
 



  





 Location:
 **Kochi** 




  





**Job Description** 




 We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to take technical ownership of the systems and interfaces powering our data platform — from database design and back\-end APIs to front\-end applications and dashboards. The role combines hands\-on development with technical leadership: setting engineering standards, guiding architecture, and mentoring engineers, while owning solutions end\-to\-end from requirements through production.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the design, development and production support of full\-stack solutions across front\-end, back\-end and database layers.
* Build front\-end applications (Vue, React, Blazor or similar) and back\-end APIs/services (preferably C\#/.NET).
* Design and evolve PostgreSQL database solutions — schemas, indexing, query performance and migrations.
* Guide architectural decisions; set and uphold standards for code quality, testing and technical design.
* Conduct code reviews and mentor engineers to build team technical capability.
* Build comprehensive automated test coverage (unit, integration, end\-to\-end) across the SDLC.
* Design and support RESTful/event\-driven APIs and distributed system integrations.
* Monitor production systems using observability/logging/alerting tools; lead incident response and root\-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with engineering and product stakeholders, clearly communicating technical trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.



  





**Key Requirements** 



* Senior/lead\-level full\-stack engineering experience, with proven front\-end work in Vue, React, Blazor or similar.
* Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS and front\-end performance/architecture skills.
* Solid back\-end experience, preferably C\#/.NET, building RESTful and/or event\-driven services.
* Strong PostgreSQL experience — schema design, query optimisation, indexing and production migrations.
* Proven ability to ship features end\-to\-end, from requirements to production.
* Hands\-on experience with unit/integration/E2E testing and driving engineering quality practices.
* Experience influencing architecture, leading code reviews, and mentoring engineers.
* Experience with data\-intensive/high\-volume systems and production operations (DevOps mindset, monitoring, observability, incident response).
* Strong analytical and communication skills, with sound technical judgement and ownership mindset.

 · Lead and manage a team of developers, providing guidance and support throughout the software development lifecycle.
 



 · Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of both front\-end and back\-end components of our software application.

 · Collaborate closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, define project scope, and ensure alignment with business objectives.
 



 · Ensure that all development processes adhere to best practices, including code reviews, testing, and documentation.
 



 · Monitor project progress, identify potential issues, and implement solutions to keep the project on track.
 



 · Promote a collaborative and innovative team environment, promoting continuous learning and development.
 



 · Drive productivity improvements by integrating AI\-powered tools and automation into development workflows, optimizing code efficiency, and enhancing team performance.
 



 Requirements
 



 · Proven experience as a Team Lead or in a similar leadership role in software development.
 



 Expertise in Java Spring Boot for back\-end development and basic experience in front\-end development.
 



 · Strong understanding of software development methodologies and best practices.
 



 · Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
 



 · Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
 



 · Exposure to software quality \& assurance
 



 · Experience with version control systems, such as Git.
 



 · Familiarity with Agile methodologies is a plus.
 



  





 Qualifications
 



 · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
 



 · Minimum of 6\+ years of experience in software development with a focus on Java Spring Boot and Basic front end developement experience . Proven experience in a leadership role is preferred.
